$comment: Generated by bin/gen-lwkopt.mjs from the reference workspace queries (LWORK = -1); read by bin/workspace-optimum.mjs (CONVENTIONS W6, ticket 0103). Per routine: `args` are Fortran argument names (options as Fortran letters; SELECT is the number of leading .TRUE. entries), `queries` the workspaces whose optimum each row ends with (WORK(1), RWORK(1), IWORK(1) as the query returns it); only calls returning INFO = 0 are rows. `noQuery`: modules with a workspace-length argument whose reference has no LQUERY. `skipped` is always empty: a routine the generator cannot sweep is an error.
